title: Geography and Deformations of $\mathbb{Z}_2^s$-Covers of General Type Over Weighted Projective Threefolds
summary: We study threefolds of general type constructed as $\mathbb{Z}_2^s$-covers of weighted projective spaces with a particular focus on their invariants, deformation theory, and the behavior of the $m$-canonical map. For the invariants, we write the ratios of the volume to the topological and holomorphic Euler characteristics as functions of the ratios of the degree of the branch divisors with respect to the total degree.
